recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. FHIR-41220 and FHIR-55967 should not be considered separately decided by this result; they are later context and remain otherwise applied, while this commit reconciles their interaction with FHIR-37847.
issue_request: FHIR-37847 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested clearer OperationDefinition.parameter.searchType documentation, input-only enforcement, redundant operations-page bullet removal, and protection against OperationDefinitions that violate opd-2.
initial_application: Commit bd263e608c193abcd2d6ad7e71d704200796e2ac added the input-only opd-4 invariant, added an explanatory searchType comment with an Evaluate Measure example, and removed the redundant optional bullet. Same-day commit e7b4eba11e0bf24c8b4452079cc80dff04c014c0 changed the initial primitive-parameter wording back to string parameters while updating OperationDefinition type bindings.
additional_context: FHIR-41220 later adjusted the operations-page wording for URL-passed parameters, and FHIR-55967 later changed Measure reporterResource inputs to DomainResource with allowed Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization types. Those later changes exposed stale searchType="reference" values on resource-typed parameters, while source/fhir.ini confirms OperationDefinition and Measure are active resources in the current build.
reconciliation: Updated OperationDefinition.parameter.searchType prose and the operations-page Search Type bullet to say searchType applies to string parameters, and removed searchType="reference" from Measure $evaluate, $care-gaps, and $collect-data reporterResource inputs because those inputs are resource values rather than string parameters.
source_changes: source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml: clarified OperationDefinition.parameter.searchType definition/comment for string parameters acting as search parameters.
source/operations.html: clarified the Search Type bullet so non-string parameter data types derive search behavior from their type rather than from OperationDefinition.parameter.searchType.
source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml: removed stale searchType="reference" from DomainResource reporterResource input.
source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-care-gaps.xml: removed stale searchType="reference" from DomainResource reporterResource input.
source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-collect-data.xml: removed stale searchType="reference" from DomainResource reporterResource input.
